title: Composition II
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: He audits the class. The class audits him.

panels.composition: A community-college classroom. Adults of every age. An INSTRUCTOR at the board: THESIS → EVIDENCE → CONCLUSION. WOOD in the back, the only one in an overcoat.

balloons.text: A thesis is a promise you make to the reader.

image.prompt: a community college writing classroom with students of all ages, an instructor at a whiteboard, a thin young man in a chore coat alone in the back row

panels.composition: Wood, writing. Not notes. A strip.

image.prompt: close-up of a young man drawing a comic strip on a pad hidden under a classroom desk

balloons.text: And what's your thesis, Mr. — you're not on my list.

image.prompt: an instructor standing beside a back-row desk looking down at a caught student with a drawing pad

panels.composition: Wood holding up the pad: a drawing of the classroom, everyone in it, the instructor mid-word, done in ninety seconds. The instructor looks at it. Says nothing. Walks back to the board.

image.prompt: a young man holding up a pad with a fast detailed sketch of the whole classroom while the instructor walks back to the whiteboard without comment

art.line: brush-pen now — the weekday deadline teaches the hand to commit; still xeroxed, still black and white
art.paper: the college paper's newsprint; the digest's quarter-letter xerox
